card.name: Rate phrases before a number per time
card.fires_on: The space, digit or small word right before a numeric amount in a rate phrase such as 'at a rate of', 'over', 'more than'. A per-time unit (per year, per hour, every week) comes next.

modes.label: Growth or loss rates
modes.description: Space before a number in a yearly rate of change.
modes.example: is occurring at an accelerated rate of over<< >>20 million km per year—more

modes.label: Infusion rates
modes.description: Digit or decimal point inside an infusion rate that is followed by mL per minute or hour.

modes.label: Stepwise change per period
modes.description: Space or linking word before an amount changed per week or other period.
modes.example: The mean incremental increase was<< >>2 to 3 ng/kg/min every

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict per-time words such as daily, yearly, monthly and weekly, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when a number is about to be given as an amount per time, like per year or per hour.
